description: Disponibilità di autobus per il trasporto pubblico locale - Serie storica is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Milano. Il dataset espone, a partire dal 2013, la disponibilità di autobus per il trasporto pubblico locale, espressa in numero di veicoli per 100.000 abitanti, nel Comune di Milano. Dataset estrapolato dalla tavola 4.1 Mobilità Urbana Istat. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Milano. Its tags are anno, seriestorica, tpl. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
